charts.title: K2-24 c: orbits around K2-24
charts.description: The orbits of K2-24's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-24 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Petigura et al. 2016 (2016ApJ...818...36P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname PETIGURA_ET_AL__2016): P 42.3633 d
